name: print-social-colorful-agency-posts-with-color-block-grids-and-ultra-bold-type
title: Colour-blocked agency pack in green, red and yellow with greyscale photos and ultra-bold caps
whatItIs: Nine square posts split into flat blocks of green, red, yellow and white, greyscale team photos in circles and rectangles, ultra-bold wide uppercase headlines ('Unlocking Potential, Building Success!', 'Ideas That Work') and yellow ovals with 'Join with us' and arrows.
whatItMeans: Loud, confident and retro-pop; the block grid feels like a bold poster wall.
techniques: Divide the square into flat colour blocks.
Run type vertically in a narrow block.
Keep photos greyscale inside colour blocks.
Use huge ovals as CTA shapes.

vocabulary.definition: Solid areas of contrasting colour side by side.
